name: pebble
description: A friendly identity for a habit-building app. Irregular rounded stones, clear cornflower blue, and an expressive but readable wordmark make progress feel human.
heading: bricolage
rules: Use asymmetrical pebbles rather than perfect circles.
Never visually rank people; use color to distinguish habits instead.
Keep encouraging headlines short and in lowercase.

system.concept: Soft dimensional stones, stacked organic frames, warm editorial annotations, and unforced friendly type. The system makes small progress feel worth noticing.
headline: One small thing.
A softer day.
system.eyebrow: A LITTLE PRACTICE / A LITTLE PROGRESS
system.productNote: Progress does not have to be loud.
features: A thoughtful beginning that can fit into your actual day.
A gentle approach to building something consistent.
Small progress, clearly seen and kindly celebrated.
system.layoutNote: Sand hero with irregular blue stone artwork and a conversational heading. Peach accents, 30px cards, and reassuring empty space; never competitive-looking progress charts.
